thesis: Hold. The shared book already has about 15% of sizing equity in broad-market VTI, at this conservative tier's single-position cap. The pack offers no strong broad-market catalyst for adding risk: most fresh items are company filings, while low VIX and slightly lower yields are offset by a still-high 5.226% 10-year yield and caution about a possible S&P 500 correction. Preserve the roughly 85% cash balance; this is a proposal only and assumes no execution.
